# pantechdynamics_team (Resource)

A team: a named group of your organization's members, to attach access policies to once for all of them. Add members with pantechdynamics_team_membership and policies with pantechdynamics_access_policy_attachment. Deleting a team removes its members and attachments, not the members themselves. At most 50 teams per organization; owners and admins only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A team groups members, so policies are attached once for all of them.
resource "pantechdynamics_team" "platform" {
  name        = "Platform"
  description = "Runs staging and production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A name unique in the organization, 1 to 64 printable characters. Changes in place.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A note for yourself, at most 255 characters. Defaults to "".

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the team was created, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the team, starting with team_.
- `member_count` (Number) How many members the team has.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A team is imported by its id.
terraform import pantechdynamics_team.platform team_06ggf7abcdefghjkmnpqrstvw
```
